summary: Go-based model router for agentic systems that intelligently routes prompts to optimal LLMs under 50ms, reducing API costs by 40-70% with a single endpoint switch.
usecases: Cost-efficient LLM routing in enterprise AI applications
Fast prompt routing for agentic workflows requiring low latency
Multi-provider model fallback and optimization in production AI services
ideas: Integrate with local model runners (Ollama, LMStudio) for hybrid cloud/edge routing
Build a dashboard visualizing routing decisions and cost savings over time
Add support for custom routing policies based on task type or user preferences
